note: In the ledger, `sources` holds indices into `sources` below, and method fields hold indices into `methods`.
methods: Exact NFC casefold row-name/native to item labels; explicit direct P31 class allowlists; non-deprecated current P131 ancestry to pinned state; all Earth P625 points <=10km. Whole-group holds for unknown identity, redirects and special/disputed territories. Duplicate requires prior #2005 finding, all current ownership gates, matching name/native/state/scope/level/population. Clear requires exactly one owner and a differently named distant place or explicit distinct administrative scope. No fuzzy match proves ownership. Population, links, full row and state are retained for review; none is modified.
